Join the Goti Health Ambassador Program

Welcome to the Goti Health Ambassador Program! We're excited to partner with individuals passionate about health and wellness to help promote our premium, USA-made supplements. Our mission is simple—create honest, straightforward, and high-quality products that help individuals and families thrive. As an Ambassador, you’ll have the opportunity to represent a trusted brand and earn commissions while promoting wellness.

About Goti Health

At Goti Health, we pride ourselves on producing premium supplements designed to support overall health. Whether it’s immunity, fitness, brain health, or beauty, our products are carefully crafted using high-quality ingredients to ensure the best results for our customers.

What Makes Us Unique?

Our Unique Selling Point lies in our commitment to transparency and quality. All of our products are made in the USA, using ethically sourced ingredients to support various health goals. From vitamins to superfoods, we cater to those who seek natural, reliable supplements for optimal well-being.

Why Join the Goti Health Ambassador Program?

By joining the Goti Health Ambassador Program, you’ll start earning a 5% commission from day one, with the chance to unlock higher rates—up to 20% commission—as your sales grow through our tiered reward system. The more you promote, the more you earn! Plus, you’ll have access to exclusive resources, special offers, and a community that shares your passion for wellness.

Payment Terms

You’ll receive monthly payouts through PayPal or Bank Transfer, based on the sales you generate through your unique referral link. With regular payments and an easy-to-track dashboard, you’ll always know where you stand and how much you’ve earned.

Join the Movement

Whether you’re a seasoned wellness influencer or someone passionate about health, Goti Health provides the platform and tools for you to succeed. Sign up today and help spread the message of good health while growing your own income.
term_and_condition:
Welcome to Goti Health!
Thank you for joining our Ambassador Program.

The following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an ambassador (“you” or “ambassador”) who refers customers to use our products or services.

By participating in the Program, you agree to abide by these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree in full, you are not authorized to register as an Ambassador or participate in the Program.

1. Registration Approval or Rejection

We reserve the right to approve or reject any Ambassador Program registration at our sole discretion. No legal recourse may be taken for rejected applications.

2. Ambassador Links and Coupons

Upon approval, you will be given a unique referral link. You can also generate links for specific products or collections. If a user clicks on multiple referral links, the last link clicked will take precedence.

You may or may not be assigned a unique coupon code. If a customer clicks on your referral link and also uses a coupon code, only one commission will be applied. Ambassadors without branded coupons are not permitted to promote non-assigned coupons.

You may advertise Goti Health via online channels (social media, blogs) or offline channels (ads, magazines, newspapers).

3. Commissions and Payments

You earn a commission based on our set commission structure for each successful referral. Commission rates depend on the order value, excluding additional fees (tax, shipping, etc.).

To receive payments, you must provide accurate payment details. Payment schedules will be available in the Ambassador Guide. Commissions are only paid for completed transactions. If an order is canceled, refunded, or charged back, no commission will be paid.

We reserve the right to review and verify all referral orders before issuing commissions. You can monitor your commission status in the Commission tab, and any paid commissions will be displayed in the Payment tab.

4. Marketing Tools

We may provide promotional resources such as banners, logos, or product-specific marketing materials through the Marketing Tool tab. You may download these resources or use the provided HTML code to promote on your channels.

5. Referral Network

If the network feature is enabled, you can invite others to join as your downline Ambassadors. For every sale made by your downline, you will earn a network commission based on merchant settings.

To invite others, share your unique network link. Any Ambassador who signs up via your link will become your downline.

6. Cookie Policy

We use cookies to track customers who click on your referral link. If customers do not enable cookies or clear their cookies, tracking may not be possible, and commission earnings will not be credited for those customers.

The cookie tracking period is specified at registration and begins when the customer clicks your referral link or uses your coupon code. During this time, any order placed by the customer will result in a commission being credited to you.

7. Removal from the Ambassador Program

If you wish to be removed from the Ambassador Program, you may do so by contacting us at: admin@gotihealth.com.

Keep Referring and Earning!

We’re thrilled you’ve made it through this important document, and we’re excited to have you onboard! You can always refer back to these terms and conditions. Should you have any questions, feel free to contact us at admin@gotihealth.com for support.
